description: QB.1 (QB spec §4.1): one monthly batch of upgrade PRs for npm packages and GitHub Actions.
Each npm PR changes one package, as docs/versions.md asks; tooling/versions fails until the PR also updates that package's row there.

Actions stay pinned to a commit SHA with the tag in a comment. Ruken-matched pins never move here: they follow Ruken's docs/versions.md (tooling/versions/src/renovate.test.ts holds the list to that file).

packageRules.description: Same as Ruken (docs/versions.md): these move only when Ruken's docs/versions.md moves.
These follow a Ruken-matched pin: the vitest browser provider (same major as vitest), the Playwright image (same tag as playwright) and Ruken's pinned changesets/action.
Every GitHub Actions upgrade in one PR, pinned to its commit.
